name: Politically exposed person as customer or controller
description: The customer, a beneficial owner or a controller is a domestic or foreign PEP, or a family member or close associate of one.
fp: Many PEPs, particularly domestic or low-level officials, are lawfully wealthy and low risk once source of wealth is understood.
